memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The Lord said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." So he met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him. Then Moses told Aaron everything the Lord had sent him to say, and also about all the signs he had commanded him to perform." - Exodus 4:27-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Forty years apart. Two brothers who probably assumed they would never meet again. And now they embrace at the mountain of God.

God arranged this reunion. He spoke to Aaron in Egypt and to Moses in Midian, and brought them to the same place at the same time. Neither had planned it.

Then Moses does something wise. He tells Aaron everything — all the words and all the signs. He does not keep the vision to himself or hold back information to protect his own position. Shared work requires shared knowledge.

There is warmth here worth noticing too. This is not a business meeting. Aaron kissed him. God's work is done by people who love each other, not merely coordinate with each other.

If God has given you a task, do not carry it alone in secret. Tell someone. Let others in. And when God restores a relationship you thought was lost, receive it as the gift it is.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is there a burden or vision I am carrying alone that I should share?
2. Which relationship do I need to entrust to God for restoration?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for the people You bring back into my life. Help me to work with others openly and with real affection. Amen.
